items.title: Israel confirms soldiers fired at car in which Hind Rajab was killed and opens criminal investigation
items.description: The five-year-old Palestinian girl initially survived the attack and pleaded for help but her body was recovered later with those of six of her relatives.

items.title: Sacked Ukrainian defence minister calls for presidential election
items.description: Martial law has been in place in Ukraine since February 2022, under which elections are suspended.

items.title: Israel opens up bids for highly-sensitive West Bank settlement project
items.description: Israeli plans to build on the area east of Jerusalem - which would divide the occupied West Bank in two - have long been internationally condemned.

items.title: South Korea shortens war games with US, citing Washington request
items.description: It comes after Trump announced plans to curtail joint military exercises with South Korea, citing a "very good" relationship with North Korea's Kim Jong Un.

items.title: Ukrainian man arrested in Croatia over Nord Stream pipeline blasts
items.description: The man is alleged to have been one of the scuba divers who planted explosives on the pipelines in 2022.

items.title: Ecuador intelligence chief and five Americans killed in Kenya helicopter crash
items.description: Michele Sensi-Contugi, and his wife Stephany Hollihan among the seven people killed in the crash.

items.title: Canada and US say they are finalising a trade deal, but details remain murky
items.description: Prime Minister Carney hailed "significant progress" in trade talks as the two countries seek to hammer out final details ahead of a new weekend tariff deadline.

items.title: Head-on collision between bus and lorry in Brazil kills more than 20
items.description: It is not yet clear what caused the two vehicles to crash into each other in the early hours of Wednesday morning.

items.title: Two detained after French influencer's scorched body found in vineyard
items.description: Sonia Bellina's body was "abandoned" after "a murder of rare savagery", the family's lawyer says.

items.title: 81-year-old confesses to German cold case murder of US tourist in 1994
items.description: Amy Lopez from Texas was last seen alive in September 1994 while on a visit to a fortress in Koblenz.

items.title: 'I was born in South Africa', says beauty queen facing legal bid to deport her
items.description: Chidimma Adetshina is challenging efforts to have her deported from South Africa, which she says is her home.

items.title: Trump administration can target Ethiopians for deportation
items.description: Judge Brian Murphy cleared the way for the Trump administration to cancel Temporary Protected Status for Ethiopians living in the US.

items.title: Watch: SpaceX rocket spotted off Christmas Island coast
items.description: A SpaceX rocket that blasted off from Texas in July, and crashed into the Indian Ocean, made an unexpected appearance off Christmas Island.

items.title: Angélique Kidjo becomes first African musician with Hollywood Walk of Fame star
items.description: Without Africans, no music is possible on this planet, says the 66-year-old musical icon from Benin.

items.title: Retail giant Target receives $1bn boost from tariff refunds
items.description: The US chain said it received a $994 million pre-tax reimbursement, which resulted in its second quarter operating income rising to $2.6bn.

items.title: Liberia agrees to accept 1,200 foreign deportees from the US
items.description: Liberia says the deal is a "humanitarian arrangement" and is receiving no compensation.

items.title: US charges 17 Iranians over 'massive' cyber theft campaign
items.description: Many of the alleged cyber attacks were carried out for the Iranian government, the Department of Justice says.

items.title: Who is Natalie Harp, Trump's right-hand woman?
items.description: One of Trump's longest serving and most loyal aides, Harp was thrust again into the spotlight when Democrat Jon Ossoff noted her closeness to the president.

items.title: Trial of mum accused of killing her three children puts postpartum psychosis on the map
items.description: Postpartum psychosis is a psychiatric emergency that can involve mania, depression, hallucinations and delusions.

items.title: French civil servant drugged us to make us urinate on ourselves, say accusers
items.description: More than 200 women accuse Christian Nègre of drugging them to make them urinate - two share their stories.
